created_for: prefab-based procedural lava exploration map handoff

runtime_rules.background: Use the 3840x2160 lava base plate plus the transparent molten-flow overlay as endless tiled parallax layers. Move them at different slow camera/time offsets so the biome feels alive without reading as fast side-scrolling terrain.
runtime_rules.platform_scale: Every platform and mega-connected room renders at native source scale. Do not shrink or enlarge at runtime.
runtime_rules.normal_route: Place adjacent platform prefabs close enough for direct movement/jump traversal.
runtime_rules.bridges: Do not generate modular bridges. Use only baked mega-connected room images when a complete bridge should exist.
runtime_rules.decorative_debris: Broken bridge pieces are non-colliding dressing only in this handoff. Keep them off required traversal paths.
runtime_rules.collision: Current rectangles are broad debug placeholders. Replace with authored top-surface polygons before production gameplay.
